title: Both-Sides Finishing Reps
description: Players finish every rep from both the left and right side of the rim in the same set, building the symmetry a defender can't predict which side will be weaker.

content.objective: Build an equally reliable finish from both sides of the rim rather than favouring one.
content.setup: Players alternate approaching the rim from the left block and the right block.
instructions: Approach from the left block and finish off the backboard.
Reset and approach from the right block, finishing the same way.
Continue alternating sides for ten total finishes.
Note which side feels weaker and spend the final minute finishing from there only.
coachingPoints: Use the same soft touch regardless of which side it's coming from.
Keep the approach angle consistent on both sides.
Be honest about which side actually needs more work.
commonMistakes: Only practising the comfortable side out of habit.
Rushing the weaker side instead of slowing down to build it properly.
Finishing off the wrong angle for the direction of approach.
content.safety: Only one player finishing at a time to avoid a collision under the rim.
